mapper.select: SELECT code, trade_avg, rent_avg, fetched_at FROM district_price_cache
SELECT code, trade_avg, rent_avg, fetched_at FROM district_price_cache WHERE code = #{code}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO district_price_cache (code, trade_avg, rent_avg, fetched_at) VALUES (#{code}, #{tradeAvg}, #{rentAvg}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE trade_avg = VALUES(trade_avg), rent_avg = VALUES(rent_avg), fetched_at = NOW()
